args.body: I read the complete catalogue-qa/buyer-alternatives/decision.json: REFRAME, retain the free bounded diagnostic and stop paid package preparation. Apply this conclusion to future work; do not expand packaging or claim free alternatives lack independent verification. No new feature, site revision or repeated comparison is justified from current evidence. Reconsider upon a concrete eligible request for the exact checks or documented material alternative gap. Existing synthetic readiness remains useful but actual case inclusion, execution and recipient delivery require separate receipts. Preserve all expiry duties.

description: Godot's forum rules explicitly prohibit AI content and paid-help solicitation, so that channel stops before implementation; this does not reject other markets. The completed catalogue comparison supports retaining the free diagnostic, not further paid packaging. Five unclassified feedback sources leave requests unknown; verified funds and revenue remain zero. Independent live experiments continue, with existing expiry duties preserved.
